summary: Iteration 16 review — Threshold alerts (backend + UI), SNMP ifAlias/MikroTik comment, Graph export (CSV+PNG for historical & live), Topology link edit/remove. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration16.py = 18/18 PASS. Playwright verified: SNMP tab on Lab SNMP Agent shows the 'Threshold alerts (Telegram)' box with all five testids (snmp-thresholds, limit-rx, limit-tx, limit-loss, limit-enabled, limit-save); saving limits with Armed off surfaces the exact hint 'Limits saved — tick “Armed” to start alerting'; ticking Armed and reloading the tab persists the state (checked=true). Interface Graphs export works — 1-day range produced lo-24h.csv with header 'timestamp,interface,rx_mbps,tx_mbps' and 9 data rows (443 bytes) and lo-24h.png (~96 KB, valid PNG signature); Live-mode CSV produced lo-live.csv (62 bytes). Topology page: 3 links visible with correct testids topo-link-<id>, topo-link-edit-<id>, topo-link-remove-<id> and canvas edges topo-edge-<id>. Clicking edit or the canvas edge opens the prefilled modal (a/b device+iface+label). Removing a link (with confirm dialog) drops the count from 3 to 2. Backend end-to-end proof of alarm delivery: enabling rx=0.001 on Lab produced a 'threshold' alarm ('lo rx X Mbps > 0.001; eth0 rx Y Mbps > 0.001') visible in GET /api/monitoring/overview.alarms (roles_notified=[] because no bot token — expected per brief); disarming stops new firings; throttling verified. Topology PUT covers 200/422 (unknown iface)/409 (duplicate)/404 (unknown id). Regression: monitor/status still lists both devices, cron/monitor-scan without token still 401, snmp/diagnose still returns from_ip.

ui_bugs.issue: Chip renders only 'DeviceA iface_a ↔ DeviceB iface_b'; the saved label is never rendered on the chip (or edge). Spec says 'saving updates the chip label'. Adjust the JSX at line 124 to append ' · <label>' when link.label is present so operators can see which link says what after editing.

action_items: (LOW) TopologyMap.jsx: show the saved label on the link chip (and optionally on the SVG edge tooltip) — currently the label persists in the API but is invisible in the UI so 'saving updates the chip label' can't be confirmed visually.
critical_code_review_comments: monitor.py check_thresholds correctly bounds rx/tx/loss and uses recently_fired for de-dup — throttle honours settings.throttle_minutes (60 in Central Ops). This means once fired, no new threshold alarm for 60 min even if the device recovers and re-breaches; acceptable but consider a separate, shorter throttle_minutes for 'threshold' since bandwidth spikes recur faster than router-down events.
monitor.py ThresholdIn: rx_mbps/tx_mbps are floats with ge=0, loss_pct is int 0..100. put_thresholds rejects all-zero when enabled=true (422). Good.

monitor.py alias handling: poll_snmp captures ifAlias (WALK_OIDS['alias']) with strip and 60-char cap; snmp_state persists it inside 'interfaces'. Topology/interfaces echoes it. SnmpPanel.jsx merges MikroTik RouterOS interface `comment` as alias fallback when SNMP alias is empty — perfect for the IDC MONITORING case that has firewalled SNMP. No 'undefined' leaks (empty string fallback).

topology.py PUT /topology/links/{id}: fetches by (id, workspace_id) so 404 works cross-workspace too; asserts both endpoints scanned (422); duplicate check excludes the record itself via id:$ne (correct — otherwise updating the label on the same link would 409). Delete-then-delete → 404. All good.

InterfaceGraphs.jsx exportCsv/exportPng correctly build CSV rows from `traffic` state and PNG via svgToPng. Live mode CSV size is 62 bytes when only one sample exists, which is expected — a header + tiny sample. No filename escaping issues observed for 'lo' but consider slugifying iface names containing '/' (e.g. 'ether1/1') to avoid invalid filenames on Windows.
TopologyMap.jsx LinkModal — reused for both create and edit, editing state prefilled from selected link. Edge click (topo-edge) opens edit modal only when canEdit && !readOnly. All correct.
TopologyMap.jsx: chip does NOT display the link.label anywhere in the UI. Backend saves it, PUT returns it, GET /api/topology returns it — but no consumer renders it. Minor UX gap flagged above.
SnmpPanel.jsx saveLimits patch: onNotice differentiates 'armed' vs 'saved — tick Armed' vs 'disabled' — matches the acceptance criterion exactly and was verified in Playwright.

iter16_api.sh (legacy script) had left behind an internal Lab lo↔eth0 link labelled 'Edited from UI'. The pytest fixture in test_iteration16.py now saves + restores it around the edit tests so the environment is not degraded.
No changes needed to WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET path — cron/monitor-scan still ack-then-work; unauthenticated request → 401 preserved.
seed_data_creation: Created + deleted transient topology links against Lab SNMP Agent (lo↔eth0 pair) for the edit tests; auto-restored the pre-existing 'Edited from UI' link after each run. Toggled Lab threshold (rx=0.001 briefly) to trigger a threshold alarm, then disarmed. Recreated the IDC↔Lab (V.211-MGMT.MX204 ↔ eth0) link after the UI remove test. Lab SNMP Agent and IDC MONITORING NOT deleted. Existing 'threshold' alarm rows remain in /api/monitoring/overview.alarms as delivery proof.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend regression: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_iteration16.py -p no:xdist -o addopts='' --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration16.xml. Snmpd on 127.0.0.1:1161 community=netpulse is running. Because Lab SNMP Agent has only 2 interfaces (lo, eth0), the topology link edit tests preserve/restore any pre-existing Lab-internal link — do not assume a clean slate on that pair. GET /api/alarms does not exist; alarm items are on GET /api/monitoring/overview → 'alarms'. Threshold alarm delivery is proven via alarm_log rows even when Telegram roles=[] (no bot token in this pod).
rca_of_the_issue: All four spec bullets (threshold alerts, alias, graph export, topology link edit/remove) function end-to-end. Only cosmetic gap: TopologyMap.jsx link chip does not render link.label. Two-line fix in TopologyMap.jsx around line 124 — append `{l.label ? ' · ' + l.label : ''}` inside the tg-pill span (and optionally show it on the SVG <title> for the topo-edge).
